svg.aria-label: Small open areas: contour around inside the wood line, or detour bypass with two 90-degree turns
svg.title: Small open areas: contour around inside the wood line, or detour bypass with two 90-degree turns
svg.text: SMALL OPEN AREAS - go round, don't cross
Both routes start at a near-side rally point and pick the azimuth up again at the far side
Stay inside the wood line on the side with
the better distance, cover and concealment
2 back on the direction of travel
Only leg 2 counts toward the pace count:
the offset legs 1 and 3 cancel out
